identity.title: Project validation changes and runtime facts

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Extend ExecutionProjection with validation summaries, scope/change facts, runtime roles/providers/models, and fallback facts derived only from normalized evidence. Label model/backend metrics as observed runtime facts, not quality scores. Dependency: 8011.project-lifecycle-outcome.
human_pressure.why_now: These are the core explainability dimensions required by the per-run governance report.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Add deterministic validation, change/scope, and runtime/fallback projections with evidence references.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8011.project-lifecycle-outcome. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Projection operates only on captured evidence.
contracts: Observed runtime reliability facts are separate from generalized model quality.
failure_semantics: Conflicting facts produce conflict/unknown state with refs rather than arbitrary winner.

steps.title: Project validation
details: status, commands/passed/failed counts, failure signatures and evidence refs.

steps.title: Project changes/scope
details: changed file count/list when provided, baseline/diff stats, scope state, forbidden touched, evidence consistency.
No git command execution during projection.

acceptance: Fallback count/reasons come from observed evidence.
Runtime provider/model fields are labeled observed facts and do not imply model quality.

must_check: All projected negative/warning facts carry evidence refs.
reject_if: Projection executes validation or git commands.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Focused runtime/validation/change projection tests plus lifecycle regression.
